messages: Hi Aira, naan Madurai la dhaan irukken, amma appa kooda. Inniku office la romba velai
Hi Tamilselvi! Madurai la irundhu velai paakureenga. Enna velai nu sollunga?
oru bank la clerk dhaan. Meenakshi amman kovil pakkathula dhaan veedu
Kovil pakkathula veedu na romba nalla area.
aama, kaalaila kovil mani satham ketkum. jigarthanda kudikka poren ipo
haha aama, romba chill ah irukku
innaiku mazhai pa, bus eruga mudiyala
Mazhai la bus pidikkaradhu kashtam dhaan. Eppadi veetuku vandheenga?
Aiyo, mazhai nerathula auto rate varum.
saapadu ku parotta salna, ammavoda kai pakkuvam
Aira, bank transfer aagiduchu, Chennai branch ku poganum, next month
Wow, Chennai ku transfer ah? Ungaluku sandhosham ah, bayama?
rendume. Madurai vittu poga manasu illa, aana promotion um irukku
ammavum appavum ipo Madurai la dhaan irupaanga
veedu paathen, Velachery la. oru PG maadhiri dhaan
Velachery nalla area, metro um irukku.
aama, 12000 rent. rmba high ah irukku
Chennai la rent high dhaan, konjam negotiate pannalaam.
Aira, naan Chennai ku vandhuten! Velachery la dhaan stay panren ipo
Welcome to Chennai Tamilselvi! Veedu set aagiducha?
konjam konjama. amma kudutha mixie vandhuruku, but gas connection innum varala
hotel la dhaan saapadu. Madurai saapadu mari illa
aama miss panren. sari neram aachu, good night
Chennai la office new team romba nalla irukanga
aama, innaiku lunch ku ellarum sernthu saapdom
ok ok, nalaiku kaalaila naalu manikku train irukku, bye

probes.expect: Says Chennai (Velachery), not Madurai, as the current city

probes.ask: naan enga irundhu vandhen? munnadi enga irundhen?
enna velai panren nu sonnen? edhu la?
probes.expect: Says works at a bank as a clerk
Says parents are still in Madurai

probes.ask: en thangachi peru enna nyabagam irukka?
probes.expect: Says it doesn't know / wasn't told; invents no name

probes.ask: naan ipo edhu area la irukken? veedu rent evlo?
